goal: Resolve a keyword-less or on-table grant's kind from the CREATE in the same migration so a grant on a newly created table is not refused as an undeclared view write, while grants on views stay detected (#3183).
prohibited_actions: No database write or structure change of any kind
assumptions: A name created in the migration as exactly one of table or view is that kind for every grant in the same migration
stop_conditions: Stop if a grant on a view created in the same migration stops producing the view key
